discovery.authorization: Verify exact same-target, current signed CredentialState and durable credential generation/digest floor. Known nonrevoked key with native read and/or write permission plus bounded collection/table grant permits placement-only discovery; operational endpoint capabilities do not grant user permissions. Unknown/malformed/revoked/foreign credentials return identical403 envelope.
discovery.credential: One Authorization: Bearer tbk1.<canonical base64url16-byte id>.<canonical base64url32-byte secret>, header <=128 bytes. No cookie/ambient credential or redirects/custom discovery hosts in SDK transport.
discovery.credential_material: SHA256 UTF8 TB-APIKEY-V1 + NUL + decoded16-byte id + decoded32-byte secret; constant-time fixed-byte digest comparison. Registry <=128 keys, raw<=256KiB, cumulative collection/table grants bounded4096 each.
discovery.credential_signature_material: UTF8 TS-CLIENT-CREDENTIALS-AUTHORITY-V1 + NUL + generationdecimal + NUL + independently pinned initial receipt lowercaseSHA256 + NUL + exact raw native registry bytes; Ed25519 base64url64 under independently anchored native authority public key.
discovery.eligibility: Current authenticated serving publication and credential floor; registered region+exact direct URL; current explicit ClientV1/read-or-write capabilities; residency filter. No REGIONS/static/config fallback can create serving eligibility.
discovery.no_store: Responses/errors private,no-store. Never return raw CredentialState, key IDs/verifiers/registry, signing material or private grants. Never log raw Authorization.
discovery.query_rules: Exact canonical native IDs; each name once; unknown names and legacy database/branch/stale aliases rejected. Observed cursor cell/deployment must match unique configured owner, never compare epochs across cells. rev is actual R3 publication sequence in that cell. Same-cell stored epoch/revision below observed cursor fails closed.
discovery.ranking: Measured RTT, then independently admitted region coordinates/client distance, then signed placement order among eligible endpoints only.

durable_floors.comparison: Reject lower policy generation; equal generation different policy bytes. Reject lower epoch, same-epoch owner flip, lower registration/publication sequence; equal sequence different snapshot or registration digest. Publisher/key replacement requires strictly newer independently signed registration sequence/digest under same current epoch+owner. Epoch replacement requires genuine current controller/operator readmission, preserves scope credential/routing floors. Equal credential generation different registrySHA and lower generations reject.
durable_floors.cross_cell: Moving a scope to another controlling cell is forbidden in this v1; requires separately frozen global scope-owner revision/floor transfer protocol.
durable_floors.object_identity: Fixed installed namespace and fixed object name atlas-native-authority-v1, never derived from policy/body/publication/owner/cell/mutable deployment/environment. First independently installed accepted policy atomically durably pins deployment/environment; any later identity change rejects. One persistent policy-authority SQLite DO centralizes all immutable scope mappings/permanent tombstones and separate per-cell epoch/owner/sequence floors, never comparing epochs across cells.
durable_floors.retry: Exact same durable sequence+snapshot digest can return duplicate ACK only after current operator/controller/context/policy/expiry revalidation. Receipt renewal cannot authorize a different same-sequence snapshot.
durable_floors.revocation: New policy removals or credential generation/tombstone floors deny previous cached snapshots. Stale Env cannot lower a recorded policy floor. Old still-valid receipts before a newly observed floor may remain usable only to conservative <=10s expiry; lifecycle stays pending until required Atlas+native ACKs or expiry. No immediate source-revocation claim.
durable_floors.state: Persist policy generation/digest/anchored mapping, publisher epoch/owner, current registration sequence/digest/key, publication sequence/snapshot digest, per-scope native credential generation/registry SHA and latest accepted snapshot. Floors survive expiry, restart and publisher replacement.

Require clock evidence issued/expiry intervals and explicit bound at the actual caller and DO expiry decision. Actual measured healthy consumer/source clocks, skew bounds and evidence bytes are independently qualified before runtime release.
receiver_policy.limits: Strict UTF8/duplicate-free/closed fields; policy <=256KiB, cells1..20, regions1..20, roots1..16 per role/cell, scopes1..256 total. Unique key IDs within each role/cell root list; reuse across separately and explicitly authorized role/cell contexts is permitted. Region codes and cell names unique; native tuples globally unique across all cells. Exact original compact policy bytes SHA256 pinned durably with generation; any changed bytes require increased generation. Cell publisher_slots must be exactly all-authenticated-publisher-ids; unknown values rejected.
receiver_policy.migration: One new_sqlite_classes migration for DiscoveryAuthority, top-level and dev bindings; no automatic deployment
receiver_policy.policy: Independently installed closed policy, never request/publication selected. Exact serialized_shape and direct-only resolver below govern; actual deployment bootstrap/root provenance and measured clock evidence remain separate release gates.
receiver_policy.removal: On accepted higher policy generation, revalidate cached publication against new tuple/issuer/interval constraints, erase serving snapshots for removed/revoked scope or root, preserve policy/credential/sequence tombstone floors, reject stale Env generations. Scope owner mapping/physical initial/native-authority pins cannot change or be reintroduced through a different cell in v1; a new scope can only be independently installed as initial assignment. Dynamic management-created assignments require signed directory successor, not manual edits presented as autonomous onboarding.
receiver_policy.resolver: Direct independently installed operator/controller roots ONLY. Delegated signers, publisher-supplied delegation documents, arbitrary issuer/root URLs and body-selected signer keys are rejected. Each configured cell root is independently authorized for all canonical authenticated publisher slots within that cell's exact pinned scope mappings; signed Envelope.scope.slot must equal authenticated Publisher-ID/body publisher_id. No separate per-publisher slot allowlist is claimed. Exact deployment/cell/environment/domain/role and current root interval remain independently constrained. Actual deployment bootstrap/root provenance remains a release gate.
receiver_policy.root_key_separation: Reject operator/controller key overlap across active installed policy; reject publisher collisions with applicable operator/controller/native authority roots. Allow explicitly installed same-role cross-cell root reuse. Root key IDs unique within each role/cell list; exact deployment/cell/role/scope intervals remain constrained.
